set(LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui)
file(GLOB LOCAL_IMGUI_SOURCES ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR}/*.cpp)
set(IMGUI_CORE_SOURCES ${LOCAL_IMGUI_SOURCES}
  ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp
  ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp)
if(WIN32)
  list(APPEND IMGUI_CORE_SOURCES ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp)
endif()
set(IMGUI_CORE_SOURCES ${IMGUI_CORE_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(IMGUI_CORE_INCLUDES ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR} ${LOCAL_IMGUI_DIR}/backends PARENT_SCOPE)
file(GLOB IMGUI_EDITOR_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ImGuizmo/*.cpp)
set(IMGUI_EDITOR_SOURCES ${IMGUI_EDITOR_SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(IMGUI_EDITOR_INCLUDES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ImGuizmo PARENT_SCOPE)
